test_title: PYST 18 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 19 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: P started walking straight towards north. After taking how many right turns during her journey she will be finally facing towards north? (she took only right turns during her journey)
solution:
Given:

P starts walking **north** and takes only **right turns**.

**1st right turn:** faces **east**

**2nd right turn:** faces **south**

**3rd right turn:** faces **west**

**4th right turn:** faces **north**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13a19ca504e909796aa78da8eb2f346f268ac1fbecbf86a8fcd7e9b958e94748.png] 

Hence, after **4 right turns**, P will be facing **north**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
